basis: Approved plan; published vendor evidence, not 2027 quotes. No supplier contacted.

sections.title: Fresh bouquets, personal flowers, ceremony pieces and centerpieces
sections.budget_scope: Within the $5,446 floral/decor cap: bouquet $300; personal flowers $220; ceremony flowers $650; centerpieces $1,600; cocktail/bar/cake flowers $150. Tax, labor, candles and other items retain separate allocations within that cap.

vendors.name: She Loves Me — à la carte
vendors.published_price: Deluxe bouquet from $285; boutonniere from $25; bud-vase trio from $75; accent centerpiece from $100; impact arrangement from $295; $500 order minimum.
vendors.scope: Finished flower products in preset palettes; packaged for someone at the event to place. Product checks: 19 $75 trios=$1,425; two $295 impact arrangements=$590.
vendors.gaps: 2027 rates and capacity; exact sage/stone/ivory palette; personal-flower count; tax; delivery; professional placement, moves and removal; no full-service labor established.
vendors.budget_status: Products plausibly fit selected line allowances; complete fulfillment remains quote pending.

vendors.name: Little Acre Flowers — à la carte
vendors.published_price: Bridal bouquet $275; boutonniere $25; floral wrist cuff $75; three styled bud vases $75. Full-service minimum $7,000; custom delivery-only proposals from $3,000.
vendors.scope: Local seasonal flowers; no minimum for à la carte on the service page. 19 bud-vase trios=$1,425 before tax/logistics. Color preferences are requests, not guaranteed exact flowers.
vendors.gaps: Product page includes a sold-out state; stock and 2027 event quantity/date must be confirmed. Delivery to selected venue, installation/strike, palette and ceremony pieces need a quote.
vendors.budget_status: À la carte is the budget route; $7,000 full-service minimum exceeds the entire $5,446 decor cap.

sections.recommendation: Quote the same modest fresh-flower list from She Loves Me and Little Acre, then pair only with a documented paid placement/strike plan. Do not treat either product total as a complete wedding floral quote.

sections.title: Arch, enclosed candles, chargers and tabletop styling
sections.budget_scope: Arch $200 and candles $650 inside floral cap; specialty linens/chargers $935 in fixed venue costs. Bundles must be itemized across their existing lines without counting labor/tax twice.

vendors.name: MICKNICS — tabletop styling and arch rental
vendors.published_price: 15+ tables $75/table for up to eight seats each, plus styling/curation fee starting $175; more than eight seats per table quoted. Plain arch stand from $75; graduated set from $125.
vendors.scope: Tabletop scope lists chargers, napkins, runners, candles, small faux centerpiece or four bud vases, some welcome/place-card elements and delivery/setup/breakdown. At 24 eight-seat tables, headline calculation is $1,975 before tax/additional charges. Plain-arch page lists up to 12 hours delivery/setup/breakdown.
vendors.gaps: Exact fresh/faux composition and style choice; enclosed real-flame vessels and venue permission; 185-place inventory; fee overlap; tablecloths versus runners; travel, tax, midnight strike, room flip, refundable damage hold. 19 ten-seat tables require a custom price. Welcome/place cards do not establish a seating chart/table numbers.
vendors.budget_status: Promising consolidated decor route, not a confirmed saving. Dinnerware is a separate add-on from $30/person and should not duplicate venue/caterer china.

vendors.name: A&A Rental Station — plain frame and rental accessories
vendors.published_price: White lattice arch $50 for one day; tripod easel $13.
vendors.scope: A plain reusable ceremony frame and support for a printed sign. Flowers and candle packages are not included.
vendors.gaps: Delivery/setup/strike, venue location/service area, taxes, rental period, frame appearance/measurements and availability must be quoted. No verified hurricane-candle inventory from these pages.
vendors.budget_status: Frame merchandise is below $200 allocation; delivered and installed total is unknown.

sections.recommendation: Ask MICKNICS for an itemized 185-person styling proposal before buying separate candles and chargers. Fresh personal flowers can remain with a florist; faux reception flowers are an explicit appearance option, not an assumed substitution. A&A is the simple-frame alternative.

sections.title: Tables, chairs, basic linens, china/glass/flatware and dance floor
sections.budget_scope: Required basic rentals, setup and rental delivery belong inside the $30,000 venue shopping target/$32,139 hard venue envelope. Specialty linens/chargers remain in their separate $935 fixed line. Rent only items missing from venue/caterer scope.

vendors.name: A&A Rental Station — transparent catalog pricing
vendors.published_price: 72-inch round $15; white padded garden chair $5; 120-inch round linen $21; napkin $1; dinner/salad plates $0.90 each; standard wine/water glasses $0.90 each; stainless flatware $0.85 per piece; 15x20 indoor dance floor $775 before installation/delivery.
vendors.scope: Available product categories can cover the missing basic rental stack. Illustrative quantities: 19 rounds plus 185 padded chairs=$1,210; setup at $6/table+$1.80/chair=$447. Seven-piece place-setting example costs $6.15/person, before additional pieces, spares, tax and logistics.
vendors.gaps: Approved floor plan/table diameter; adequate dance-floor size; inventory185; serving/buffet/cake/cocktail tables; linen drop; delivery service to exact venue; stairs/elevators/time window; tax; table setting, wash-up, restacking, strike and late pickup. Tailgate delivery is not room placement; items must return clean and packed.
vendors.budget_status: Useful price benchmarks only. No complete 2027 rental or labor quote; do not replace full model allowances with these incomplete subtotals.

vendors.name: Brooke Rental Center — alternative consolidated quote
vendors.published_price: Complete event pricing unpublished on checked readable pages.
vendors.scope: DC/MD/Northern Virginia rental supplier for tables, chairs, linens, glassware and broader event equipment; in-house and special-order linen categories.
vendors.gaps: Every price and185-person inventory; exact setup/strike obligations; delivery and late pickup; rental duration, damage/cleaning charges and correct sizes/colors. Saturday office closes at noon and Sunday is closed; a late-event arrangement must be explicit.
vendors.budget_status: Quote pending; compare the same itemized list with A&A and venue/caterer inclusions.

sections.recommendation: Use A&A as the transparent catalog benchmark and Brooke as the competing consolidated quote. First subtract documented venue/caterer equipment. Rental discounts do not excuse inadequate seating, table space or a small dance floor.

sections.title: Physical setup, room flip, flower placement and end-of-night strike
sections.budget_scope: Decor delivery/placement/move/removal allowance $700, plus $411 uncommitted floral allowance if needed within the same category. Furniture setup/flip/strike and required access hours are venue-driven costs. Coordination is a separate $2,500 function.

vendors.name: Elilta Events — setup and breakdown crews
vendors.published_price: Custom quote; minimum service hours apply but number/rates unpublished.
vendors.scope: Official FAQ offers decor setup, table settings, breakdown/cleanup and setup/breakdown crews for weddings in DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia; reports large-event staffing capability.
vendors.gaps: Named crew size, shift lengths, split shifts/return trip, delivery handling, fresh-flower placement and moving, candles, tableware washing/packing, furniture flipping, final trash and departure; business/insurance credentials accepted by the venue; tax/travel/minimums and2027availability.
vendors.budget_status: Best targeted standalone physical-labor inquiry; no claim that $700 covers the complete job.

vendors.name: A&A Rental Station — its own furniture setup
vendors.published_price: Setup $6/table and $1.80/chair, booked in advance. At19tables/185chairs: $447 before delivery/tax and additional work.
vendors.scope: Setting out its rented tables/chairs; delivery otherwise arrives stacked.
vendors.gaps: Does not establish table dressing, flower/candle placement, mid-event flip, end-of-night restacking, washing, or late pickup. Quote all required work and equipment transport separately.
vendors.budget_status: Venue-envelope labor option for missing furniture setup only; not a substitute for the decor crew.

vendors.name: MICKNICS — its own rented decor installation
vendors.published_price: Quoted styling fee; $175 starting fee described with tabletop pricing; full venue design starts $1,500 before separately priced rentals/materials.
vendors.scope: Delivery, styling and breakdown of selected supplier-owned rentals are described. A bundle may remove duplicate work if the same tasks are covered.
vendors.gaps: Whether staff will handle separately purchased fresh flowers/client-owned decor, room flips, exact final collection time and additional labor; full venue design fee alone exceeds $700 decor-labor line.
vendors.budget_status: Use bundled installation when its scope covers the job; do not presume coordination or rental drop-off covers other suppliers' items.

sections.recommendation: Assign every physical task to one named paid provider. At The Villa, added flowers/decor require licensed-professional placement and removal unless a written exception applies. Keep affordable flowers conditional on a compliant labor plan.

material_constraints: All 2027 availability and final prices remain unknown.
The Villa requires licensed professional placement/removal for added flowers/decor; exception must be written.
Nineteen tables is provisional. MICKNICS base table pricing covers eight seats;185people requires24such tables.
A&A returned tableware must be clean and in original containers; this affects staffing and venue kitchen suitability.
No named supplier has yet confirmed all required decor labor within $700.
No new savings may be counted from a bundle until the exact same scope is removed once from existing lines.
limits: Catalog arithmetic excludes unquoted tax, delivery, installation, stock/date confirmation and other required items; it is not a modeled complete venue price. Price years are unknown unless explicitly dated; copyright years are not price years.
